name: UCSF ImmunoExplore Summer Camp
what_you_do: Free summer camp at UCSF's Parnassus campus with lectures, games, patient panels and live anatomy dissections, mentored by UCSF students.
who_can_apply: Bay Area high school students who have limited chances to take part in biomedical research. Grade range not posted.
deadline_text: The page says 2026 camper applications were open (the page title still says Summer Camp 2025). No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Fill in the Google Form linked from the ImmunoExplore page.
notes: The page looks out of date: it is titled Summer Camp 2025 but mentions 2026 applications, and gives no grades, dates or deadline. Confirm everything with ImmunoX before relying on it.
